milestone_order: CS-M3 all testing and paid acceptance

chosen_platform.web_api: Vercel static CDN + standard Python Functions
chosen_platform.queue: existing pgmq extension, new CS-only queue
chosen_platform.media_storage: new private creative-studio bucket in existing Supabase project
chosen_platform.compiler_compute: api/worker.py Python 3.12 Function importing existing core
chosen_platform.ffmpeg_compute: same bounded Python worker child process with pinned Linux ffmpeg/ffprobe
chosen_platform.provider_wait: persist next due poll/webhook in DB; return HTTP

entrypoints.auth: Supabase JWT plus current workspace authority
Standard Webhooks raw-body signature + account binding; no unsigned fallback
CS worker secret from scheduler Vault; exact release/environment checks

configuration_notes: The Vercel object is design material, not a ready-to-deploy file; M2 generates exact packaging/routing for the selected FastAPI adapter and preserves request path using trusted original URL routing.
Pin Python to 3.12 through pyproject.toml/.python-version; pin frontend/runtime dependencies in lockfiles.
Confirm region availability and keep service near eu-north-1; record selected region.
Explicit static output + Python API configuration avoids serving ui/server.py. No production filesystem path endpoints.
No beta large-functions or containers are required. Standard worker bundle must remain <500MB.
Deployment protections must permit provider access to production webhook alias while application data remains authenticated; do not generate or publish bypass links.

environment.name: CS_WORKER_SECRET
environment.constraint: distinct from BCI and provider credentials; Vault copy used by scheduler

environment.name: CS_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1
environment.constraint: AES256GCM key; no JWT signing key reuse

environment.name: CS_STORAGE_WORKER_CREDENTIAL
environment.constraint: dedicated Auth principal; only CS Storage RLS permissions

environment.name: CS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environment.constraint: exact production origins; no credentialed wildcard

environment.name: CS_MOS_CLIENT_PUBLIC_KEYS
environment.constraint: registered integration keys with kid and expiry

environment.name: CS_BCI_API_ORIGIN
environment.constraint: exact approved Brand CI service origin

environment.name: CS_PROVIDER_WEBHOOK_SECRETS
environment.constraint: prefer encrypted account-scoped records; never global implicit workspace fallback

forbidden_runtime_secrets: shared SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY inherited from local compiler

scheduler.execute_if: dispatch flag enabled AND due work AND free bounded slot
scheduler.request_body: opaque work-item hint/environment/release; no provider keys or payload

release.cs_m2: build and deployment receipts, no tests or provider generation
release.rollback: compatible recorded Vercel deployment + dispatcher release target; no down migration; reconcile pending provider state
release.provider_activation: separate explicit media budget and intended credential after assembled build

rendering.font_source: approved immutable font AssetRefs only; explicit --use-font-file
rendering.font_fallback: refuse missing glyph/face or unsupported layout; no silent substitution
rendering.ffmpeg_distribution: source-built Linux x86_64 binary, signed source provenance, exact build recipe and hashes recorded in M2
rendering.ffmpeg_license_handling: GPL-enabled libx264 binary; preserve applicable notices and corresponding source/build recipe

transitions.method: render normalized outgoing tail and incoming head; omit overlap handles from bodies; stream-copy final body/transition/body concat
transitions.audio: same frame timeline, bounded final audio mix

pre_run_operations.compile_admission: POST W/plans ->202 operation, Location W/operations/{id}; completed operation result_refs includes plan
pre_run_operations.paid_authoring: explicit action ->same ledger/attempt receipts under operation_id, draft treatment only; no fake plan/run
